summary_1line: Ravana rides in splendor to the golden assembly hall of Lanka and summons his ministers and warriors to prepare for an impending conflict.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana stands in a thunderous golden chariot under a shining white canopy while demon warriors with weapons march and elephants rear around him.
Inside a vast golden hall built by Vishvakarma, Ravana sits on an emerald throne surrounded by rows of bowing demons and guarded by sinister spirits.
Hundreds of armored titans enter the glittering assembly hall like lions entering a rocky cavern to gather before their king.
